{{Quote|Constancia... that planet outside... the one with the ring!|C-3PO|<ref name="The Constancia Affair" />}}
'''Constancia''' was the [[Constancian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

[[File:Constancia_city.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] landing on Constancia]]

A number of [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]] settled on the planet, after their first [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] found the experience of telepathic intimacy exhilarating enough to encourage her people to follow her. Within [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], a colony of Zeltrons had arrived.<ref name="GMR" />
